clips.title: The story
paras: At Apothecary Johaan's hand, Laced Pumpkin turns an ordinary gourd into a deadly test of Forsaken alchemy. In Brill, the Royal Apothecary Society seeks weapons against the Scourge and living human forces.

In Tirisfal Glades, the pumpkin looks like ordinary produce salvaged from blighted soil. Apothecary Johaan in Brill treats it with experimental toxins meant to realize the full potential of undeath. The Royal Apothecary Society seeks weapons against the Scourge in the north and living human forces advancing from the south. Even a simple harvest can carry infection and chemical death.
